[[File:Olivier.png|thumb|250px|Olivier]] '''Olivier''' (Japanese: '''オサバキ''' ''Osabaki'') is a character who appears in ''[[DP131|Pedal to the Mettle!]]'' and ''[[DP132|Evolving Strategies!]]''. He is a traveling [[battle judge|referee]] who had been called by [[Reggie]] to preside over Ash and Paul's [[Full Battle]]. He told {{Ash}} where the battle with [[Paul]] was going to take place, and also refereed their match. Olivier travels via hot air balloon, which also contains a screen, similar to the ones used in tournaments, such as the [[Pokémon League]]. He also hired {{TRT}}—who were in disguise—to help him in updating the scoreboard.
